text:
anna (eng-platform): short proposal: publish a single stable header `X-RW-Error-Bucket` + `X-RW-Error-Code` so clients and the console can show consistent messaging during rollouts. keeps things low-cardinality.
ben (eng-runtime): agreed on low-cardinality. question: do we map buckets to HTTP codes or keep them orthogonal? e.g. 429 still for rate, 503 for infra, but bucket tells UX what to show.
carla (prod-ux): orthogonal is cleaner for UX. we want deterministic copy per bucket. also need a preview mode in console so tenants can see exactly what users would see if a request fails.
dave (eng-infra): telemetry request: index `error_bucket` and `error_code` as tags. sample `human_message_id` and `hint_payload` to avoid cardinality explosions. we should also enforce a registry for `error_code` values.
anna (eng-platform): proposed enums: bucket={quota,backpressure,input,auth}. codes are tiny set per bucket, e.g., quota: {soft_limit,hard_limit,overage_block}; backpressure: {gradual,evict,capacity_full}. I'll add the full mapping to the RFC.
eli (docs): can we standardize a `human_message_id` like `msg.quota.soft_limit.v1` so docs & console can pull canonical copy by id instead of embedding text in headers? that way we can iterate the copy via docs without changing headers.
ben (eng-runtime): nice. SDKs then do two-phase resolution: prefer `hint_payload` if present (small structured key-values), else fall back to `human_message_id` -> fetch localized copy from embedded table or docs endpoint (cached). keep parsing tolerant for older SDKs.
carla (prod-ux): sample UX copy we want in console (one-liners):
- quota.soft_limit -> "You're close to your quota. Try lowering concurrency or enabling batching."
- quota.hard_limit -> "Quota exceeded. Upgrade plan or contact sales to increase limits."
- backpressure.capacity_full -> "Service under load. We recommend retrying in a few seconds or reducing batch size."
- input.invalid_schema -> "Request invalid. Check schema and retry."
anna (eng-platform): header example for transport:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-RW-Error-Bucket: backpressure
X-RW-Error-Code: capacity_full
X-RW-Human-Message-ID: msg.backpressure.capacity_full.v1
X-RW-Hint-Payload: retry-after=3;reduce_batch=true
```
ben (eng-runtime): one caution: headers can leak info in logs. let's ensure `hint_payload` is limited to non-sensitive keys and we sanitize values (no tenant ids, no long freeform). also default to not emitting `hint_payload` for cross-tenant logs.
dave (eng-infra): agree. we'll add a sanitizer that strips anything matching email/ARN patterns before logging and sample the hint payload only on 1% of traces.
eli (docs): I'll prepare the canonical copy table and localized strings, plus an endpoint used by SDKs for mapping `human_message_id` -> localized text. docs will include examples and migration notes.
carla (prod-ux): rollout UX: admin toggle to enable header preview per-tenant (off by default). also a simulator to replay a failed request and show console messaging and SDK representation. helpful for support.
anna (eng-platform): migration plan notes: start canary w/ headers on 5% for internal tenants, after 1 week increase to 25% and patch SDKs to read headers safely. deprecate old ad-hoc subcodes in 3 months.
ben (eng-runtime): will add small runtime plumbing. won't change status codes. adding feature flag to turn headers on/off at host-level.
dave (eng-infra): I'll wire up dashboards: stacked area `error_bucket` over time per-tenant, and a breakdown table for `error_code` frequency. keep `human_message_id` as sampled metadata for debugging.
deploy-bot: canary roll started for `error-bucket-headers` on 5% hosts. monitor `error_bucket` tag and support slack channel. :rocket:
anna (eng-platform): open questions: legal review on user-facing hints? internationalization? thoughts on whether SDKs should auto-surface client hints or just expose them?
carla (prod-ux): prefer SDKs expose a one-line suggestion and a machine-readable hint object. default to not auto-retry; let app decide. will coordinate with legal on phrasing for paid-plan upsell messages.
eli (docs): i'll loop in translations team. also will document header examples and recommend what to log vs what to redact.
ben (eng-runtime): ack. will PR a tiny SDK patch that exposes `errorBucket`, `errorCode`, `hint` and `humanMessageId`. non-breaking.
anna (eng-platform): thanks all 44d i'll file the RFC with enums, header shapes, logging rules, and the deprecation timeline. reviewers: @ben @carla @dave @eli
